name: Zoey
source: Zoey is [url=/c121269]Natalie[/url]'s only daughter. Her father, Tyson, died within the last year, and she still struggles with the grief, but her blatant cheerfulness and energy keep her mother and the rest of the characters in high spirits whenever she is around. Unfortunately, she struggles with making friends at school, being viewed as mean after lashing out at a girl who was bullying her.
